description: Propose and (optionally) apply remediations. Dry-run by default.

tools.name: propose_remediation
tools.description: Given a finding or issue id, produce a dry-run patch. With container/manifest/finding: strategic-merge patch naming the containers; otherwise a JSON patch on the first container plus missing_inputs. Never mutates the cluster.

issue.description: Issue id or rule name, e.g. missing-resource-limits, runAsNonRoot

container.description: Container to patch. Else taken from finding.resource (.../container:<name>) or manifest; if unknown, a JSON patch on the first container is returned.

manifest.description: Optional resource YAML (multi-doc ok) used to find the real container names.

tools.name: propose_remediation_llm
tools.description: LLM-assisted fallback for ShrikeOps findings the deterministic rules cannot fix. Deterministic propose_remediation rules run first (generator=rules); otherwise the configured provider (LLM_PROVIDER=vertex|openai|ollama|avirka) drafts a strategic-merge patch that must pass strict parsing, a field denylist, a ShrikeOps re-scan (no score regression, no new findings) and, when a cluster is available, kubectl apply --dry-run=server. Output is a dry-run Proposal labelled generator=llm. Never mutates the cluster; fails closed when the provider or its API key is not configured.

issue.description: Issue id or rule name (defaults to finding.id)

manifest.description: Resource YAML (multi-doc ok). Required for the LLM path (used for the re-scan).

cluster_context.description: Optional Heron Ops cluster_* output (string or object), passed to the model as untrusted data

server_dry_run.description: Run kubectl apply --dry-run=server when a cluster is available (default true)

tools.name: apply_remediation
tools.description: Apply a previously proposed patch. Requires readwrite mode, namespace allowlist, and confirm=true. Prefer dry_run=true first.

container.description: Container to patch. Else taken from finding.resource (.../container:<name>) or manifest; if unknown, a JSON patch on the first container is returned.

manifest.description: Optional resource YAML (multi-doc ok) used to find the real container names.

patch.description: Patch body (JSON or YAML) from propose_remediation

confirm.description: Must be true to apply when dry_run=false

tools.name: sandbox_project
tools.description: Render an isolated per-project sandbox namespace (PSA restricted, default-deny NetworkPolicy + DNS, ResourceQuota/LimitRange, ServiceAccount without token automount, optional hardened read-only-root Job). Dry-run manifests only; never mutates the cluster.

image.description: Optional pinned task image; renders a sandbox Job
